question: Do two route-specific mediator payoffs turn the locally admitted Dusk packages into distinct held-out Vow-5 endpoints without broad RandomBuild movement or reliability regression?

shippingChangesAtThisStage: Duskblade Chisel applies one Scoreline; Faultline consumes it for 12 or 15 bonus damage and completes the target's remaining Facets.
Duskblade Ward applies one Afterimage; Warden's Edge consumes it to deal damage equal to three times the current Ward.
The balance pilot gives Ward twice its existing aspect setup value only when Warden's Edge is in hand and no Afterimage is held.

researchCohorts.screen: root 527, policy indices 0-511, seeds 305000-305003, Duskblade Vow-5
researchCohorts.repertoireValidation: selected route-active cells, seeds 306000-306063, paired candidate/live Duskblade Vow-5

estimands.functionalSeparation: Every named diagonal lower 95% bound is at least 0.25 SD and every off-diagonal upper bound is below 0.25.
estimands.globalMovement: Candidate-minus-live RandomBuild arm-2 point movement is at most 0.10 per grid.
estimands.routeViability: Each Dusk route has at least two held-out policies at least 0.35 above paired RandomBuild.
estimands.reliability: No candidate-added stall or simulator error.
estimands.vow5: Every selected-policy Vow-5 win rate is at most 0.90.

successRule: All local and control gates admit, then each Dusk route retains two distinct Vow-5 endpoints with zero reliability regression and the Vow-5 ceiling.
inconclusiveRule: Only a non-decisive panel may extend once to 128; the route screen and held-out rectangle are final.
stopRule: Reject on a local gate, controls, fewer than eight active screen cells per route, fewer than two held-out endpoints, collapse, added fault or Vow-5 above 0.90.
